headline: Powerica bags new business orders and contracts
summary: Powerica Limited has announced to the stock exchanges that it has received new orders and contracts. The company operates in the power sector, handling various energy and equipment projects. Further financial details or the identity of the clients were not disclosed in the filing. Retail investors should track order book updates to gauge the company's near-term revenue visibility.
whats_next: Financial disclosures in upcoming quarterly earnings
why_it_matters: Order inflows boost revenue visibility for Powerica.

headline: Powerica shares jump 48% above IPO price as Nuvama issues Buy call
hook: Strong post-IPO gains attract fresh broker interest
summary: Powerica shares have risen 48% above their IPO price, prompting brokerage firm Nuvama to issue a Buy call with an expectation of 20% further returns. The brokerage's bullish stance is supported by specific growth drivers detailed in its recent note. Indian retail investors tracking recent IPO listings may note this momentum, though individual stock decisions depend on personal risk appetite.
why_it_matters: Brokerage outlook highlights post-listing momentum for recent IPO investors
winners_losers: Powerica shareholders gain / new buyers face higher entry cost
